hooks.name: Fit check
hooks.description: Type /fit to have the agent review the working-tree diff against grid-rules.md and editorial.md before a commit.

action.prompt: The user asked for a fit check. 1. Run `git diff --stat` and `git diff` (read only). 2. Read .kiro/steering/grid-rules.md and .kiro/steering/editorial.md. 3. For every changed line under src/grid, src/markup, src/compilers, src/editor or pages/, check: nothing can reach the store without validateGrid; no row can exceed 40 cells; no number is written by hand instead of through src/compilers/format.ts; no validator, schema or test was loosened. 4. Run `npm run -s grid:check`. 5. Answer with one line per rule: PASS or FAIL, with file and line for each FAIL. Change no file.
